'''Gokhan''' is a Lord of [[the Blood]] who serves in the [[Ever Victorious Army]].{{ref/book|14|32}}

== Activities ==
After Empress Fortuona discovers [[Min Farshaw]]'s ability as a [[Doomseer]], she orders Min to record several [[Min's viewings|viewings]] about [[Seanchan]] soldiers. Min sees white lace trailing in a pond, and knows that he will marry in the near future. As a result, the Empress sends Gokhan to the front lines, as she can be certain that he will survive the [[Last Battle]]. 

== Trivia ==
* Gokhan is named for Gokhan Ipek, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
